recognize_zh: 組織切片中大量中型細胞核呈圓形至不規則、染色質細緻、細胞質稀少，片狀取代正常組織；殘存的巨核細胞與小而深染的紅血球母細胞散在其間，提示淋巴母細胞浸潤骨髓。
features: Sheets of intermediate-sized cells with round to irregular or convoluted nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm
Scattered small dark round nuclei of residual erythroid precursors
describe_en: Section of hematopoietic tissue, likely bone marrow, shows sheets of intermediate-sized cells with round to irregular, focally convoluted nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. A residual megakaryocyte and scattered small hyperchromatic erythroid precursors are present among the infiltrate. Findings are consistent with infiltration by lymphoblastic lymphoma/leukemia; immunohistochemistry (TdT, CD3, CD79a/PAX5, CD34) is required to confirm lineage.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts often have more cytoplasm and nucleoli and are MPO/CD117 positive, whereas lymphoblasts are TdT positive and MPO negative.
Blastoid mantle cell lymphoma is TdT negative and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.
Burkitt cells have multiple small nucleoli, basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, starry-sky macrophages and are TdT negative with MYC rearrangement.
